rationale: The target is a complete, nonvacuous statement of the norm axioms for the exact psi-two gauge from equation (2.13). Its measurable finite-gauge carrier is the source's sub-gaussian domain, and its quotient by a.e.-zero functions supplies the only natural equality convention under which the source's expectation-based functional is a genuine norm. The ENNReal infimum, finite-domain restriction, toReal conversion, and explicit integrability condition faithfully encode positive finite scales and finite expectations. No centering, independence, altered constant, asymptotic comparison, or missing norm law is present, so both semantic implication directions hold.
